|                          | **Morphine **                                                   | **Tramadol **                                                                        |

| **MOA **                 | Full opiate agonist, primarily MOP                              | Racemic Mixture                                                                      |
|                          |                                                                 |                                                                                      |
|                          |                                                                 | Tramadol: NA and 5-HT reuptake inhibitor                                             |
|                          |                                                                 |                                                                                      |
|                          |                                                                 | Weak MOP agonist                                                                     |
+--------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Genetic Variability ** | Glucuronidation to M6G and M3G with low genetic variability     | CYP2D6 metabolism to active O’Desmethyltramadol with genetic polymorphism            |
+--------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Analgesic Effect **    | Potent MOP Agonist ↑dose →efficacy until all receptors occupied | Partial MOP agonist (reduced efficacy)→ ceiling effect where ↑dose does not ↑ effect |
|                          |                                                                 |                                                                                      |
|                          |                                                                 | O’Desmethyltramadol significantly more potent opioid against then tramadol           |

+--------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
